scope: Fresh N513 exploratory and N1025 primary duration trials with explicitly modified telegrapher gauge and inner closure.
method: At 0<r<1, advance conformal lapse as a total in RK4 stages, apply the same physical lapse floor, and convert to log storage. Other evolved variables, endpoints, sources, shift solve, and constraints remain unchanged. Compensation accounts for log-storage roundoff; restart binds lapse_update.
pilot: Fresh N257 and N513 trials to500 are exploratory duration tests; no convergence claim.

principal_n1025.primary_invariant: apparent-horizon mass; interior errors excluded from budget

limits: Passing one resolution is duration evidence only; retain floor activation, clipping, interior extrema, and all failures. No constraint projection, shift cap, or adaptive timestep silently added.

gauge_change.log_lapse_flux: (1+epsilon)*chi/[alpha+epsilon*A]*div(wB), bounded as alpha tends to zero
gauge_change.scope: Gauge modification; reference-background strength s=1, extra propagation attenuated near collapsed lapse. Not a continuum stability theorem.

inner_closure: positive-radius-only derivative and advection stencils; AF endpoint coefficients stay evolved but do not enter bulk finite differences; no excision of positive-radius nodes.
failed_controls: Total-lapse update alone, endpoint closure alone, and direct-total-field derivatives did not establish stability; N257 attenuation pilots have unacceptable exterior errors and are not evidence of a repair.
